% Polarisation of the $+v_A$ (incoming) mode

% Reflection coefficient (linear order)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E2_reflection}
R \equiv \tilde z^+\bigr|_{\mathrm{ghost}}/\tilde z^-\bigr|_{\mathrm{int}} = 0\quad\text{when } v_x^{\mathrm{drv}} = 0

% z-polarised Alfvén channel (not driven in v1)
